The Passion Residence Lagoon

Townhouse in Ko Kaeo
HomeSaleThe Passion Residence Lagoon

Project overview

A boutique development of seven newly built townhomes in the Ko Kaeo area near Boat Lagoon, completed in 2025. Each home has its own layout, with parking, a garden and security on site.

The Passion Residence Lagoon: key facts

  • The Passion Residence Lagoon is a townhouse in Ko Kaeo, Phuket.
  • Units: 3 bedrooms, 170 sqm.
  • Construction status: completed; completion listed as Jun 2025.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿4,900,000.
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Royal Phuket Marina (10 minutes, driving); Siam Niramit Phuket (10 minutes, driving); British International School Phuket (10 minutes, driving); Surin Beach (25 minutes, driving).
